subject: design/existing-repo-onboarding-v2
statement: the install-epoch is the already-present `epoch.commit` config field (`design-brainstorm:…#F-2`); `apply` records the repository's current commit into it and **creates no commit of its own** — the operator commits the adoption, so adoption makes no undisclosed change to history (DINV-4; `prd:existing-repo-onboarding/J1`). The tree-local gates honour it by a **single `git diff --name-only epoch.commit..HEAD` (∪ working-tree changes) computed once per gate run and intersected with the scan-set**: only content changed since the epoch is checked, so the grandfathered corpus is never visited and gate cost scales with the changed set, not the corpus (DINV-6; NFR-1). History-scoped checks (immutability, governing) already compare against a ref and are unaffected. An unreachable epoch commit (a shallow clone) **fails closed** — gate everything, naming the cause. The per-check grandfather exception lists remain available for targeted exceptions alongside the epoch (NR-3).
